messages:
Maya: Heads-up 1 — FinEdge POC starts tomorrow 09:00 ET. They asked for a single-page summary: how many reserved GPUs to buy, autoscale behavior for 3-8min surges, recommended preheat steps, and whether quantized runtime needs extra license.
Arjun: Traffic sketch? avg vs peak?
Maya: Their SRE sent: steady 220 qps embeddings, 80 qps generation; spikes to ~1.4k qps lasting 3-8 minutes (usually 2x daily). 95p embedding target 140ms. Business-hours SLA Mon-Fri 07:00-19:00 ET.
Ben: Ballpark: reserve for steady + 15% headroom -> ~3.5 A100-eq, round up to 4 reserved GPUs. Autoscale ceiling to 8 GPUs with burst credits seems reasonable for those spikes.
Claire: They asked for AZ spread. Recommend symmetric 2+2 if they require failover with minimal tail-impact. If budget tight, 3+1 can work but call out degraded 95p when failover occurs.
Maya: Can someone paste a concise preheat runbook they can follow? Need it short for the questionnaire.
Arjun: Use this 3-step runbook (copyable):
1) Schedule preheat 30m before expected peak.
2) Run KV replay at ~30% of expected peak for 5 minutes.
3) Run synthetic QPS soak at 50% for 5 minutes, confirm KV hit-rate >= 80%, then proceed.
If preheat fails, enable burst credits and notify Redwood oncall.
Ben: Autoscale policy (paste into their ops ticket):
```json
{ "autoscale": { "min_reserved_gpus": "4", "max_gpus": "8", "scale_step": "1", "cooldown_seconds": "180", "preheat_window_minutes": "30", "burst_credit": "enabled", "burst_qps_cap": "2000" }}
```
Ben: cooldown 180s to avoid flip-flopping during short spikes; burst_qps_cap prevents one customer from exhausting shared burst pool.
Claire: Licensing: quantized runtime is included under platform infra fee. Legal prefers a contract line: "Redwood provides quantized inference runtime as part of platform services; no separate runtime license applies." I'll add that to the draft.
Maya: Pricing ask: they want a blended quote (reserved + burst). Presales rule: reserved = monthly commit rate; burst credits sold as hourly blocks at an incremental rate; cross-AZ reservation +4% infra surcharge. Ben, can you pull example numbers?
Ben: I'll attach a template with sample prices after this thread. For the one-pager, use bullets: reserved monthly unit price, burst-credit block price, cross-AZ surcharge note.
Arjun: Observability checklist we need to include in the security questionnaire: per-route token counts, 95/99/99.9 latency percentiles, KV hit-rate, preheat run status, audit log of who triggered preheat; all available via Console and API. Note: metrics are aggregated and PII redacted before storage.
infra-bot: Reminder: maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00 UTC. Please schedule preheat outside this window. :warning:
Maya: Good catch. We'll schedule preheat earlier.
Claire: Quick ops note: We'll recommend they run the KV warmup using our k6-based load generator; I'll attach a minimal script. Also suggest a small synthetic driver to exercise quantized variant.
Ben: Draft action list: (1) Maya to produce one-pager with sizing rationale, autoscale snippet, preheat runbook, pricing bullets, license line (2) Ben to add pricing numbers and attach template (3) Claire to attach KV warmup + synthetic scripts (4) Arjun to prep telemetry QA text. Aim to send to FinEdge within 2 hours.
Maya: I'll draft and post here for review in ~90 minutes. Ping me if anything else needed. :rocket:
